newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Aug crude steel output down 1.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Japan Aug crude steel output down 1.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Japan's crude steel production in August was 8.01 million tonnes, down 1.0 percent from a year ago, marking the 13th successive month of year-on-year declines, the Japan Iron and Steel Federation said on Tuesday.
Output in August was down 1.3 percent from the previous month, it said in a statement.

August output of tin plate was 135,700 tonnes, down 2.7 percent year on year, and down 5.7 percent month on month. Production of galvanised steel sheet in August was 881,900 tonnes, down 2.2 percent year on year, and down 6.1 percent month on month, the federation said.
